verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal coding agent with its own code-editing tools. It can make structure-aware AST edits and return LSP diagnostics for errors or warnings an edit introduces, which supports diagnostic-driven fixes. However, the evidence never names test writing, lint fixing, merge-conflict resolution, or dependency updates. `mastracode update` updates the tool itself, not project dependencies. Missing for 10: documented test generation, explicit lint-error fixing workflow, merge-conflict resolution, dependency updating, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: Edit code using abstract syntax tree (AST) analysis for intelligent, structure-aware transformations.
Returns Language Server Protocol (LSP) diagnostics showing any errors or warnings introduced by the edit.
